scope: Canonical build succeeded; unchanged pinned production runner failed during eager host system-data mounting before original PE launch. No original menu/game render was reached. No engine compatibility defect established; no repair/retest.

deviations.detail: Static require/canonical WAT source closure and original 92 assets passed, but unconditional runtime SYSTEM_DATA_FILES were not included. stdole2.tlb absence was found by the single production-runner invocation, rather than before provisioning. No guest execution or render acceptance.

PNG/controller smoke used --max-old-space-size=512, whereas task prescribed 256 MiB for smoke. Compile/guest and their exact-configuration startup checks used prescribed 512 MiB. Actual PNG-smoke RSS and all CPU/wall/output limits are preserved; this is not a retroactive compliance claim.

Watchdog and cutoff offsets used ready-event receipt time, 4.853 seconds after actual createdAt, rather than creation. Actual guest attempt ended at 13:00:46Z and actual snapshot-stop completed 13:01:04Z, more than 16 minutes before even the stricter creation-based guest cutoff. No operation approached either cutoff.
